facts.text: Caroline has been seeking counseling and mental health jobs to help others with their mental health journeys.

evidence.quote: I'm still looking into counseling and mental health jobs. It's important to me that people have someone to talk to, and I want to help make that happen.
I started looking into counseling and mental health career options, so I could help other people on their own journeys like I was helped.

facts.text: Caroline's personal experience with mental health struggles and the support she received motivated her to pursue a career in counseling.

evidence.quote: I struggled with mental health, and support I got was really helpful. It made me realize how important it is for others to have a support system.

facts.text: Caroline values the role of books in her life, as they guide, motivate, and help her discover who she is.

evidence.quote: Books guide me, motivate me and help me discover who I am. They're a huge part of my journey.

facts.text: Caroline was inspired by a book with a gold coin on its cover, which reminded her to keep going and never give up.

evidence.quote: This book I read last year reminds me to always pursue my dreams, just like you are doing!🌟 [image: a photography of a book cover with a gold coin on it]
Seeing this pic just made me appreciate my love of reading even more.
